/Connector Catalog/Xero Accounts/Actions

Actions

The Xero Accounts connector exposes the following clients:

ClientPurpose
ClientInteract with the Xero Accounting API to manage invoices, contacts, payments, bank transactions, financial reports, and all other accounting resources.

Client​

The Client connects to the Xero Accounting API (https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0). It exposes 235 operations. Every operation takes the Xero tenant ID of the organisation in its headers record.

Configuration​

ConnectionConfig

FieldTypeDefaultDescription
authhttp:BearerTokenConfig|OAuth2RefreshTokenGrantConfigRequiredConfigurations related to client authentication
httpVersionhttp:HttpVersionhttp:HTTP_2_0The HTTP version understood by the client
http1Settingshttp:ClientHttp1Settings{}Configurations related to HTTP/1.x protocol
http2Settingshttp:ClientHttp2Settings{}Configurations related to HTTP/2 protocol
timeoutdecimal30The maximum time to wait (in seconds) for a response before closing the connection
forwardedstring"disable"The choice of setting forwarded/x-forwarded header
followRedirectshttp:FollowRedirectsOptionalConfigurations associated with Redirection
poolConfighttp:PoolConfigurationOptionalConfigurations associated with request pooling
cachehttp:CacheConfig{}HTTP caching related configurations
compressionhttp:Compressionhttp:COMPRESSION_AUTOSpecifies the way of handling compression (accept-encoding) header
circuitBreakerhttp:CircuitBreakerConfigOptionalConfigurations associated with the behaviour of the Circuit Breaker
retryConfighttp:RetryConfigOptionalConfigurations associated with retrying
cookieConfighttp:CookieConfigOptionalConfigurations associated with cookies
responseLimitshttp:ResponseLimitConfigs{}Configurations associated with inbound response size limits
secureSockethttp:ClientSecureSocketOptionalSSL/TLS-related options
proxyhttp:ProxyConfigOptionalProxy server related options
socketConfighttp:ClientSocketConfig{}Provides settings related to client socket configuration
validationbooleantrueEnables the inbound payload validation functionality which provided by the constraint package. Enabled by default
laxDataBindingbooleantrueEnables relaxed data binding on the client side. When enabled, nil values are treated as optional, and absent fields are handled as nilable types. Enabled by default.

Initializing the client​

import ballerinax/xero.accounts;

configurable string clientId = ?;
configurable string clientSecret = ?;
configurable string refreshToken = ?;
configurable string refreshUrl = ?;
configurable string tenantId = ?;

final accounts:Client accountsClient = check new ({
    auth: {clientId, clientSecret, refreshToken, refreshUrl}
});

Operations​

Accounts​

getAccounts

Retrieves the full chart of accounts.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
headersGetAccountsHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation). Optional: ifModifiedSince.
'wherestringNoFilter by an any element.
'orderstringNoOrder by an any element.

Returns: Accounts|error

Sample code:

accounts:Accounts result = check accountsClient->getAccounts({xeroTenantId: tenantId});

Sample response:

{
  "Accounts": [
    {
      "Status": "ACTIVE",
      "AccountID": "297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9",
      "Description": "Sample description"
    }
  ]
}
createAccount

Creates a new chart of accounts.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
headersCreateAccountHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation). Optional: idempotencyKey.
payloadAccountYesAccount object in body of request.

Returns: Accounts|error

Sample code:

accounts:Accounts result = check accountsClient->createAccount({xeroTenantId: tenantId}, {
    status: "ACTIVE",
    description: "Sample description",
    showInExpenseClaims: false,
    code: "200"
});

Sample response:

{
  "Accounts": [
    {
      "Status": "ACTIVE",
      "AccountID": "297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9",
      "Description": "Sample description"
    }
  ]
}
getAccount

Retrieves a single chart of accounts by using a unique account Id.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
accountIDstringYesUnique identifier for Account object.
headersGetAccountHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation).

Returns: Accounts|error

Sample code:

accounts:Accounts result = check accountsClient->getAccount("297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9", {xeroTenantId: tenantId});

Sample response:

  "Accounts": [
    {
      "Status": "ACTIVE",

updateAccount

Updates a chart of accounts.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
accountIDstringYesUnique identifier for Account object.
headersUpdateAccountHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation). Optional: idempotencyKey.

Batch Payments​

getBatchPayments

Retrieves either one or many batch payments for invoices.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
headersGetBatchPaymentsHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation). Optional: ifModifiedSince.
'wherestringNoFilter by an any element.
'orderstringNoOrder by an any element.

Returns: BatchPayments|error

Sample code:

accounts:BatchPayments result = check accountsClient->getBatchPayments({xeroTenantId: tenantId});

Sample response:

{
  "BatchPayments": [
    {
      "Status": "AUTHORISED",
      "BatchPaymentID": "297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9",
      "UpdatedDateUTC": "2026-01-15T00:00:00"
    }
  ]
}
createBatchPayment

Creates one or many batch payments for invoices.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
headersCreateBatchPaymentHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation). Optional: idempotencyKey.
payloadBatchPaymentsYesBatchPayments with an array of Payments in body of request.
summarizeErrorsbooleanNoIf false return 200 OK and mix of successfully created objects and any with validation errors. Defaults to false.

Returns: BatchPayments|error

Sample code:

accounts:BatchPayments result = check accountsClient->createBatchPayment({xeroTenantId: tenantId}, {
    batchPayments: [{
        reference: "REF-001",
        amount: 100.00,
        code: "200"
    }]
});

Sample response:

{
  "BatchPayments": [
    {
      "Status": "AUTHORISED",
      "BatchPaymentID": "297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9",
      "UpdatedDateUTC": "2026-01-15T00:00:00"
    }
  ]
}
deleteBatchPayment

Deletes one or more batch payments by setting their status to DELETED.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
headersDeleteBatchPaymentHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation). Optional: idempotencyKey.
payloadBatchPaymentDeleteYesBatch payments to delete, each identified by ID with status set to DELETED.

Returns: BatchPayments|error

Sample code:

accounts:BatchPayments result = check accountsClient->deleteBatchPayment({xeroTenantId: tenantId}, {
    batchPaymentID: "297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9",
    status: "string"
});

Sample response:

{
  "BatchPayments": [
    {
      "Status": "AUTHORISED",
      "BatchPaymentID": "297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9",
      "UpdatedDateUTC": "2026-01-15T00:00:00"
    }
  ]
}

Bank Transactions​

getBankTransactions

Retrieves any spent or received money transactions.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
headersGetBankTransactionsHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation). Optional: ifModifiedSince.
unitdpintNoE.g. unitdp=4: (Unit Decimal Places) You can opt in to use four decimal places for unit amounts.
referencesstring[]NoFilter by a comma-separated list of References.
pageSizeintNoNumber of records to retrieve per page.
'wherestringNoFilter by an any element.
pageintNoUp to 100 bank transactions will be returned in a single API call with line items details.
'orderstringNoOrder by an any element.

Returns: BankTransactions|error

Sample code:

accounts:BankTransactions result = check accountsClient->getBankTransactions({xeroTenantId: tenantId});

Sample response:

{
  "BankTransactions": [
    {
      "LineItems": [
        {}
      ],
      "BankAccount": {},
      "Type": "RECEIVE"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "pageCount": 1,
    "pageSize": 1,
    "page": 1
  },
  "Warnings": [
    {
      "Message": "string"
    }
  ]
}
createBankTransactions

Creates one or more spent or received money transaction.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
headersCreateBankTransactionsHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation). Optional: idempotencyKey.
payloadBankTransactionsYesBankTransactions with an array of BankTransaction objects in body of request.
unitdpintNoE.g. unitdp=4: (Unit Decimal Places) You can opt in to use four decimal places for unit amounts.
summarizeErrorsbooleanNoIf false return 200 OK and mix of successfully created objects and any with validation errors. Defaults to false.

Returns: BankTransactions|error

Sample code:

accounts:BankTransactions result = check accountsClient->createBankTransactions({xeroTenantId: tenantId}, {
    bankTransactions: [{
        lineItems: [{}],
        bankAccount: {},
        'type: "RECEIVE"
    }],
    pagination: {
        pageCount: 1,
        pageSize: 1,
        page: 1
    }
});

Sample response:

{
  "BankTransactions": [
    {
      "LineItems": [
        {}
      ],
      "BankAccount": {},
      "Type": "RECEIVE"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "pageCount": 1,
    "pageSize": 1,
    "page": 1
  },
  "Warnings": [
    {
      "Message": "string"
    }
  ]
}

Contacts​

getContacts

Retrieves all contacts in a Xero organisation.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
headersGetContactsHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation). Optional: ifModifiedSince.
includeArchivedbooleanNoE.g. includeArchived=true - Contacts with a status of ARCHIVED will be included in the response.
summaryOnlybooleanNoUse summaryOnly=true in GET Contacts and Invoices endpoint to retrieve a smaller version of the response object. This returns only lightweight fields, excluding computation-heavy fields from the response, making the API calls quick and efficient. Defaults to false.
searchTermstringNoSearch parameter that performs a case-insensitive text search across the Name, FirstName, LastName, ContactNumber and EmailAddress fields.
iDsstring[]NoFilter by a comma separated list of ContactIDs. Allows you to retrieve a specific set of contacts in a single call.
pageSizeintNoNumber of records to retrieve per page.
'wherestringNoFilter by an any element.
pageintNoE.g. page=1 - Up to 100 contacts will be returned in a single API call.
'orderstringNoOrder by an any element.

Returns: Contacts|error

Sample code:

accounts:Contacts result = check accountsClient->getContacts({xeroTenantId: tenantId});

Sample response:

{

    "pageCount": 1,
    "pageSize": 1,
    "page": 1

getInvoices

Retrieves sales invoices or purchase bills.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
headersGetInvoicesHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation). Optional: ifModifiedSince.
includeArchivedbooleanNoE.g. includeArchived=true - Invoices with a status of ARCHIVED will be included in the response.
invoiceNumbersstring[]NoFilter by a comma-separated list of InvoiceNumbers.
pageSizeintNoNumber of records to retrieve per page.
summaryOnlybooleanNoUse summaryOnly=true in GET Contacts and Invoices endpoint to retrieve a smaller version of the response object. This returns only lightweight fields, excluding computation-heavy fields from the response, making the API calls quick and efficient. Defaults to false.
searchTermstringNoSearch parameter that performs a case-insensitive text search across the fields e.g. InvoiceNumber, Reference.
statusesstring[]NoFilter by a comma-separated list Statuses. For faster response times we recommend using these explicit parameters instead of passing OR conditions into the Where filter.
createdByMyAppbooleanNoWhen set to true you'll only retrieve Invoices created by your app.
unitdpintNoE.g. unitdp=4: (Unit Decimal Places) You can opt in to use four decimal places for unit amounts.
iDsstring[]NoFilter by a comma-separated list of InvoicesIDs.
'wherestringNoFilter by an any element.
pageintNoE.g. page=1: Up to 100 invoices will be returned in a single API call with line items shown for each invoice.
'orderstringNoOrder by an any element.
contactIDsstring[]NoFilter by a comma-separated list of ContactIDs.

Returns: Invoices|error

Linked Transactions​

getLinkedTransactions

Retrieves linked transactions (billable expenses).

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
headersGetLinkedTransactionsHeadersYesRequest headers, including the required xeroTenantId (the Xero tenant ID of the organisation).
statusstringNoFilter by the combination of ContactID and Status. Get the linked transactions associated to a customer and with a status.
targetTransactionIDstringNoFilter by the TargetTransactionID. Get all the linked transactions allocated to a particular ACCREC invoice.
sourceTransactionIDstringNoFilter by the SourceTransactionID. Get the linked transactions created from a particular ACCPAY invoice.
